title: Effects of wastewater treatment plant effluent on the gut and whole-body microbiomes of aquatic and riparian invertebrates in the Grand River, ON
description: Pharmaceuticals and personal care products (PPCPs) released into waterways can impact aquatic and riparian invertebrate health. This study assesses how the discharge from wastewater treatment plants impacts the microbiomes of riparian spiders, freshwater mussels, and benthic macroinvertebrates in the Grand River (Ontario, Canada).
